name: Conditions Indicator
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 837.5010.X222.A1.xml — new segment for Phase 2, reused across 4 distinct 'roles' in this IG (Ambulance Certification, Patient Condition Information: Vision, Homebound Indicator, EPSDT Referral) purely via CRC01's own qualifier value. CRC04-07 (independent condition-code positions, same 'not a repeat group' reasoning as 999's own IK5/AK9 — see segments/IK5.json) are usage=N in some roles but genuinely used (S) in others (e.g. Ambulance Certification uses up to 5 condition codes) — kept as the permissive union across all 4 roles, matching CTX.json's own established precedent.
